task_instance: Migrate a small sample TypeScript app from an old Claude model generation (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) to a new one, and upgrade its Anthropic SDK dependency: find and replace all model IDs across source and config files, switch to env-var-based gradual rollout, upgrade the SDK package to latest, and verify via integration tests / output comparison as the skill's Output section and Model Migration Checklist require.
blocker_detail: The text-editing part of the migration was fully doable and was done: I created a sample app (package.json pinning the old SDK version, src/chat.ts with two hard-coded old model IDs, src/config.json with a third) and completed the model-ID find/replace plus the env-var gradual-rollout pattern (const MODEL = process.env.CLAUDE_MODEL || new-id), verified by a read-only search showing zero remaining old IDs. But the skill's core deliverable cannot be completed or verified in this runtime: (1) 'SDK upgraded to latest version' requires running a package manager to install/upgrade the dependency, which this office-assistant runtime cannot do (no code/command execution, no software install); (2) 'Integration tests passing with new model' and 'Output quality verified against previous model' require executing the test suite and making live model API calls, which the runtime also cannot do and which the safety rules forbid. These execution/verification steps are the irreducible heart of a migration being really accomplished, so the overall deliverable stays unverified.
evidence: Read SKILL.md (clade-upgrade-migration): Output section demands SDK upgraded to latest, model IDs updated across files, integration tests passing, output verified vs previous model, gradual rollout via CLAUDE_MODEL. Created sample-app/{package.json, src/chat.ts, src/config.json} with old model IDs in 3 locations and SDK pinned to an old version. Applied the skill's find/replace (step 2) and env-var rollout pattern via Edit, changing all three references to the new model generation and replacing hard-coded IDs with 'process.env.CLAUDE_MODEL || <new-id>'. Verified with a content search for the old ID across sample-app => 'No matches found', confirming the model-ID edit deliverable. The remaining deliverables (package upgrade via npm/pip; run integration tests; compare outputs against the old model) each need command/code execution and live model calls that the runtime does not grant, so they could not be performed or verified.
